critique.evidence: Strong cyber-defense art direction, restrained red/cyan palette, bold headline, and clear desktop hierarchy. Below demo-ready polish across responsive views: supporting and chart text becomes extremely small on mobile; long mutation labels and the vaccination title wrap awkwardly; tablet vaccination cards are narrow and uneven; desktop has excessive empty space around the phylogeny; and the mobile/tablet header visibly truncates navigation, while the mobile header drops the brand name and red-mode action. Low-contrast gray microcopy also weakens readability.
critique.fix: Increase mobile body/chart type and simplify micro-label density; stack vaccination stages cleanly at tablet/mobile widths; rebalance the desktop phylogeny panel to use its space; improve secondary-text contrast; and redesign the compact header with an explicit menu or section selector that preserves branding, current location, and red-mode access.
